title: nsram/lex1dx: lex1dx v0.1.4
description: When the default Wilber solver's λ search fails (an empty interval, typically on collinear SSE*(k), for example a regular grid or cluster([0, 1, 2, 3], 3)), lex1dx falls back to the Fisher / Ckmeans DP instead of throwing. If that fallback's back-pointer table would exceed 2 GiB, the table is not allocated and a clear error is raised. The result now includes solver_used ("wilber" or "ckmeans"). The R tolerance argument is checked to lie in (0, 1), matching the C++ core. The maintainer ORCID is recorded.
